releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.6

- Integrated Xenia Edge upstream through November 20, 2026. This brings updates across CPU and system emulation, graphics, audio and game content handling while preserving X360 Mobile's Android features and existing fixes.
- Improved handling of game updates and Android storage access. Updated the in-game interface and input handling.
- Continued work on reducing shader-related pauses at the beginning of **Fable II**. New scenes can still pause while shaders are prepared.

Focused checks on Odin 2 covered gameplay in **GTA IV**, **Forza Horizon 2** and **Fable II**, as well as pause, resume and shutdown in **Assassin's Creed**. Results can vary across titles, devices and drivers.

TV mode, synced player profiles and picture-in-picture remain experimental. You can install this release over your current version.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

## Driver diagnostics and session sharing

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

- **Battle Cut-ins Missing Fixed (Fixes #4):**

releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

**省流：** 新增设置内的中英文切换，默认中文；修复观片台长按拖选和启动兼容问题，补齐性能测试、处理队列及大图尺寸提示。

内部安装版本码递增为 **128**，沿用原发布签名。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

- 设置中选择中文或 English，立即更新界面，保留当前照片、配方与编辑；重启后记住语言。胶卷、风格和参数搜索支持中英文名称。修复启动时过早访问 Activity 主题导致的崩溃，并回归首次启动与已有状态恢复。
- 观片台长按按实际触点选中照片；松手不再撤销选择。跨行拖选提前消费移动事件，避免首个大幅垂直移动被滚动抢走；保留普通滑动、边缘自动滚动和双指缩放。
- 性能测试直接在设置里显示首次预览、换风格、导出和建议。系统不允许读取峰值 RSS 时，增加独立的阶段采样 PSS 增量，注明可能漏掉峰值，并说明尺寸建议未按峰值内存筛选。采样放在计时渲染段之外，不替换内存准入规则。
- 处理队列在空闲时显示正确状态，区分已保存与已取消；明确重启后保留最近 30 条已结束记录，清除记录不会删除相册照片。工作尺寸和缩图提示说明设置、GPU、内存的共同上限，保留用户原尺寸选择。
- HEIF 主图 EXIF 尺寸与实际输出一致；外部文件重复打开走现有 Activity，文件提供器的异步读取可取消。JNI 在取消检查完成前继续持有显示像素，避免失败路径提前释放。
- `.spklook` 导入统一限制解压总量，未知条目、重复条目和目录内的附带数据也计入预算，避免跳过条目时继续无限解压；正常风格、色表与缩略图格式保持兼容。

11 月 14–15 日 Xiaomi 13 Ultra / Android 16 的候选版本实测覆盖中英文重启、观片台拖选、批量导出、JPEG / TIFF / HEIF、后台保存、取消重试及 24 MP 合成输入。该设备实测单缓冲上限 128 MiB，大图实际工作尺寸为 3547×2364；不是全尺寸 24 MP 成片。最后一个实测候选为 `c4a45e5`，本次新增 PSS 采样和队列文案在手机拔出后以云端回归验证，尚未再次安装真机。

发布由完整云端构建、JVM / 界面回归、RAW 与 Vulkan 数值检查、原发布证书和 16 KiB 对齐检查把关。既有实测数据见 [扩展真机记录](docs/ALPHA8_EXPANDED_DEVICE_2026-11-14.md)，最终审计与发布验证见 [Alpha 8 发布记录](docs/ALPHA8_RELEASE_2026-11-15.md)。

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-6
releases.body:
**省流：** 不选胶卷也能只用滤镜保存图片，自定义组合保存得更完整；RAW 少占一些内存，测光和曲线少做重复计算。界面保持原样，未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

内部安装版本码递增为 **126**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 滤镜和胶卷自由搭配

- 胶卷选“无”后，数字调色和 LUT 继续生效，可通过原有保存入口导出图片。胶卷、相纸和数字调整按用户现有选择组合，不增加模式或范围控件。
- “存为风格”和“分享当前风格”记录当前完整选择，包括明确的无胶卷状态、物理细调、效果开关及记住的强度；重新套用时不再漏掉这些设置。局部蒙版留在当前照片，RAW 白平衡、裁切和边框不进入可复用风格。
- 新版 `.spklook` 写出 version 2，并继续读取旧 version 1 文件。旧应用不能保证还原 v2 的全部新语义；自定义配方基于已有胶卷、相纸及参数，每张图仍使用一个物理方案和一个数字调色层 / LUT。

### RAW 少复制，计算少重复

- 对满足条件的整数 RAW，将解码结果直接转换到工作尺寸，避免先创建完整的浮点中间图；最终 Bitmap 分配前释放已用完的原始存储。
- 对严格兼容的整数 LinearRaw 子集，一次性处理直接接管已有像素存储，减少一份整图复制。浮点精度路径、黑白点及方向处理保留原有约定，并检查取消和失败时的存储状态。
- 同一次显示计算只准备一次曲线；自动测光和场景亮度统计复用已完成的精确分区，减少重复选择工作。逐项对照保留原有数值结果，没有更换胶片光谱、默认显影或成像公式。
- 吸收上游 Sony Huffman 解码缓存索引保护，保留合法索引的既有计算；尚未用真实问题 Sony 原片完成复现验收。

### 验证范围

本轮分项云端验证包含 172 项 Release JVM 测试、3 项原有界面风格保存 / 导入测试、完整 LibRaw 的 ASan / UBSan 检查、ARM64 JNI 编译，以及测光和场景统计的 1460 项数值对照；真实 Vulkan 胶片与印放对照输出保持一致。发布仍须通过整包构建、原生回归、签名证书及 16 KiB 对齐检查。

**未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。** 云端的耗时及内存改善不等于手机整张导出同比提速，也不保证所有 RAW 都降低峰值。新 RAW 仍默认线性显示，递归模糊、交互色表及完整外存分块实验继续默认关闭。

releases.name: Spektralab-X 0.2.00-alpha-5
releases.body:
**省流：** 修复异常像素被当成正常照片保存，出错后重建引擎重算。未大规模真机验证，需要社区反馈。

这次集中处理社区 [#17](https://github.com/Dear-Ded/Spektralab-X/issues/17) 反馈的窄条画面、黑块和紫色色块。暗房里算坏的底片，不能盖个“保存成功”就交卷。

内部安装版本码递增为 **125**，沿用原发布签名，可覆盖安装。本轮共创：**GPT（OpenAI，AI 助手）**。

### 修复异常像素被放行

- 修复浮点 RGB 中的 NaN、正负无穷在转成整数时丢失错误信息的问题。这些值原来会变成黑色或偏色像素，alpha 和文件结构却仍然正常；只要局部还有画面，旧的纯色检查就可能放行。
- 现在在整数转换和结果缓存前扫描全部 RGB 通道，记录首个异常像素的位置和通道；同时检查扫描工作组是否完整执行。异常结果停止交付，不进入后续保存。
- 导出前还会核对 RGBA16 布局及每个有效像素的 alpha，拦截未完整写入的结果。普通 Bitmap 导出、胶片 JPEG 4:4:4 和 RGBA16 TIFF 共用这项检查。

### 出错后重新开一间暗房

# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2611/)
You know the drill, it's been around a month so that means we have a new release landing. A smattering of changes all over the codebase this time.
Let's see what's interesting!

## CPU core index through TPIDRRO_EL0
This is a fun feature that has come about primarily because Windows on ARM mandates this feature. The [TPIDRRO_EL0](https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0601/2026-09/AArch64-Registers/TPIDRRO-EL0--EL0-Read-Only-Software-Thread-ID-Register?lang=en) register

contain the current CPU core index once read. This gives ARM64/ARM64ec applications a really quick way to read what core it is executing on. This is
kind of a funny thing that needs to exist because **technically** the MPIDR_EL1 register is supposed to accomplish the same task. Although this

# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2610/)
We were a bit distracted this month with the [X.Org Developer's Conference](https://indico.freedesktop.org/event/12/) happening but we still managed
to get some work done. Let's jump in and see what has changed.

## JIT changes
This month brought some improvements to the JIT although less than typical. We added support for AVX-VNNI which is starting to get used by some game

We also now have a software fallback for RDRAND and RDSEED instructions. This isn't enabled by default as the performance isn't as good as a hardware

**"Kept you waiting, huh?"** - Solid Snake, professional sneaky man.

A bunch of random bug fixes and performance improvements landed this month. Primary things here are that there were various behaviour fixes for some

There's more of course but come on we gotta go!

releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2608/)
After what felt like a very quick month, it's time for another FEX release. We're busy writing improvements for next month's release already, so let's
not distract for too long and smash through these changes!

## Removal of deprecated FEXInterpreter binary
Back in the [FEX-2510](/FEX-2510) release we completely removed a **FEXLoader** binary with a deprecation of the **FEXInterpreter** binary, renaming it to
just **FEX**. We kept the FEXInterpreter binary around for a while because downstream projects had hardcoded the binary in their scripts and we wanted to give
some time for them to migrate. After nearly a year we're hoping that everyone has migrated to the new binary name. If your project is still using the
old binary name then we recommend fix them!

## The typical JIT improvements
As typical there are a bunch of JIT changes this month. Let's breakdown  what was fixed.

- Use SVE XAR for SHA1 emulation as a minor optimization.
- Fix JIT telemetry value unconstrained predictable problem on ARMv8.0
  - Would only cause some missed telemetry on ARMv8.0 platforms, very minor.

releases.name: Grand-V Mobile
releases.body:
v4.2.1 — Native ARM64 AOT Engine, Multi-Threaded GPU Pipeline & Mission Control Fixes

This release moves the game engine from on-device JIT compilation to ahead-of-time (AOT) native ARM64 code with ThinLTO optimization, cutting first-launch setup from minutes to instant startup, eliminating the ~200 MB `.cwasm` cache, shrinking the APK to ~280 MB, and delivering major FPS, frame-time, and thermal gains across both Story Mode and GTA Online.

. Native ARM64 AOT Engine (wasm2c + ThinLTO): instant startup (no 2–4 min first-launch compile), zero `.cwasm` cache, lower CPU heat, and smoother 1% lows
. Multi-Threaded GPU Pipeline & Memory Pools: async command encoding/submission, mapped upload staging pool, vertex/index slab sub-allocator, and key-first bind-group cache (+24% FPS and ~50% lower renderer overhead)
. Smaller APK & Smarter Profiling: removed unused 63 MB `game.wasm` (~280 MB APK), expanded SoC profiling (Snapdragon, Dimensity, Exynos, Tensor), parallel BC/ETC2 texture decode, and native ARM64 NEON `zlib-rs` decompression

releases.body:
## Type your own names

Until now your hunter was always called "Flip", because the console's on-screen keyboard did nothing in the port. Now, naming your hunter, Palico or Palamute opens a text box with Android's keyboard:

- **✓** on the keyboard (or **OK**) accepts. **Back** cancels and keeps the old name.
- The game's maximum length is respected. If the game rejects a name, the box opens again with the game's message.
- An empty file `sin_teclado` in the game folder brings back the old behaviour.

Thanks to the player who reported it in issue #3.

Nothing else changes: graphics, frame rate and shader caches are the same as in 1.5.0, so your existing caches keep working.

## Installing

Install the APK over the previous version (your settings and saves stay) or follow the [README](https://github.com/IamWilmar/mhrise-recomp#install-and-first-run) for a first install.

## En español

- **Escribe tus propios nombres.** Al nombrar al cazador, al Felyne o al Canyne se abre un cuadro con el teclado de Android. ✓ u OK aceptan y Atrás cancela. Se respeta el largo máximo del juego. Con un fichero vacío `sin_teclado` en la carpeta del juego vuelve el nombre automático de antes.

releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

- **Races keep their real speed.** The original game moves the race forward by a fixed step every frame, which was fine on the Xbox, where it runs on a fixed 30 FPS. On the Switch, in rain, with nitrous or in the busiest streets, the frame rate can dip and the whole race then went into slow motion. The race now proceeds by the time that really passed. Racing in the rain and with nitrous feels much steadier.
- **No more random zooms during loading screens.** Menus and loading screens are drawn for 4:3 TVs, with black strips at the sides, and the port enlarges them to fill your 16:9 screen. When something briefly reached those strips (the circle animation on loading screens for example), the picture behind it jumped in size for a brief moment. The size stays put now.

# BluBox 360 0.16.3 public alpha

BluBox 360 0.16.3 focuses on easier updating and safer sustained performance on Android handhelds such as the AYN Thor.

## Check for updates

- Added a **Check for updates** button under **Settings > App**.
- Automatic update checks keep the existing 15-minute cooldown.
- A manual check runs immediately and ignores the automatic cooldown.
- Manual checks now confirm when BluBox is already up to date.
- Manual checks show an error message if GitHub cannot be reached instead of silently closing.

## Smart Heat Guard

- Low Heat Mode remains available and still avoids maximum-clock requests.
- BluBox now checks Android thermal status and thermal headroom when a game launches.
- When Android reports thermal pressure, BluBox uses the low-heat launch preset even if Low Heat Mode was switched off.
- A 60 FPS target can be reduced to a 30 FPS safety ceiling when the device is already approaching thermal throttling.
- Shader creation is reduced to one worker under thermal pressure to lower sustained CPU load.
- Fable II keeps its existing 24 FPS safety ceiling.
- The existing severe-heat protection remains enabled during gameplay.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev fixes crashes triggered by some achievements and events, improves native Vulkan and PanVK compatibility, and expands launcher localization and crash reporting.

## Gameplay and stability

- Fix a crash triggered by achievement and event names containing a colon, including `Endless: Backup Plan`. The offline Steam bridge now handles those names and returns errors for individual rejected storage operations.
- Fix parsing of numbered save names such as `Name-3`. Add Win64 runtime support for wide-string integer parsing, numeric conversions and C++ exception-message handling.
- Handle requests for the offline Steam store overlay and external menu links without launching a browser.

## Rendering and touch controls

- Extend experimental Native Vulkan (PanVK) and DXVK (PanVK) checks to Mali and Immortalis devices on Android 11 or newer. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages. Devices with other page sizes can import a compatible driver and run the launcher check.
- Restore missing ground snow when starting a new game in native Vulkan by correcting how the renderer caches texture bindings.

- Use PanVK with either renderer on supported Mali devices. Import a custom driver from a ZIP or an ARM64 `.so`, or restore the bundled driver. Fix yellow-tinted snow and buildings under PanVK, fullscreen display artifacts on the Lenovo TB373FU, and missing scout portraits and a stray temperature-indicator arc on Mali-G615.
- Fix bundled Turnip selection and support the Qualcomm system driver on compatible Adreno 830 devices. Improve Vulkan upload synchronization and surface recovery, DXVK fullscreen handling, and diagnostics for stalled frame presentation.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
Experimental Android ARM64 update focused on memory controls, graphics settings, driver management, and crash diagnostics.

## Changes

- Add Auto, Normal, Reduced, and Minimum memory modes. Automatic selection adapts to available device RAM without overwriting saved graphics preferences.
- Show a one-time low-memory warning when Android reports 7.5 GiB of RAM or less.
- Add model detail and building model quality controls, with both defaulting to their lowest levels. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Improve geometry simplification and graphics profile handling, and show output resolution in pixels and percentages.
- Restore normal city updates and rendering while paused by removing forced update suppression and frozen-frame reuse.
- Support landscape and reverse landscape only, including gamepad attachment and the crash monitor.
- Bundle one shared purple-turnip T30 driver for GPU checks and gameplay, with Mesa license text and driver provenance included.
- Add Turnip release browsing and downloads with byte progress and cancellation. Cache verified downloads for offline reuse and allow removal of unused external drivers while preserving the active driver.

releases.name: Frostpunk for Android 0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Launcher compatibility update for Frostpunk for Android.

## Changes

- Keep the launcher usable when the device or selected renderer cannot run the game.
- Show insufficient Vulkan versions and missing GPU features in the Play card instead of a forced-exit dialog, including when game files are not yet installed.
- Preserve renderer selection and the compatibility checks that guard game startup.
- Update the APK to version `0.1.1-dev`, version code `3`.

## Installation and requirements

Download **Frostpunk-0.1.1-dev.apk** and its **.sha256** file from the assets below.
Install the APK, then select your supported Steam PC game folder or compatible stored ZIP in the launcher. Existing installations can be updated with the same Android signing certificate.

Running the game requires Android 11 or newer, a 64-bit ARM device, a compatible Vulkan 1.3 GPU and driver, and the player's own supported Steam PC game files. Adreno uses Turnip; supported Mali and PowerVR configurations use system Vulkan. An incompatible device can still open and use the launcher.

No original game files, extracted assets, saves, or game-data ZIPs are included in this release.

## Galar Native v0.94

### A steadier 30 fps with Graphics on Auto (#289 #300)
With Graphics on Auto, the game now starts at 85 % of its full 3D resolution (about 900p) and settles from there:
- It holds 30 for a calm minute: it goes up to the full resolution.
- It falls short of 30: it goes down to 720p.
- The phone gets hot: it goes down to 720p, and no lower for heat alone. Only a frame rate under 30 goes lower.

Before, the game started at full resolution and slower phones spent minutes under 30 before it stepped down. Under 30 the game also runs slower than normal, which looks like slow motion. If you picked a 3D render scale by hand in the menu, your choice is kept and Auto doesn't change it.

## Galar Native v0.93

### Fixed: crashes on game threads with tiny stacks
Some of the game's threads have very small stacks (16 KB). Our handling of the game's system calls ran on those stacks, and on some phones (when Android was tracing) it ran past their end and crashed. That handling now runs on a stack of its own. releases.name: Galar Native v0.91
releases.body:
## Galar Native v0.91

### Faster shader setup (#262)
Most of setup's shader time wasn't the translation, it was files. Setup kept its working files in `Android/data/…/files/setup_work`, where Android passes every file through a slow storage layer: on a Galaxy S25+, 10,000 small files took 26 s to write there and 0.5 s in the app's private storage. Setup writes about 130,000 of them.

- The shader steps' working files now go in the app's private storage. It's the same storage chip, so setup needs no more free space than before. `setup.log` and the unpacked game stay where they were.
- Packing the shaders compresses on every core at a faster setting, with the same result: 194 s → 7 s on a PC.

This applies to a full setup and to the automatic shader update. On a PC limited to 8 cores, translating all 38,501 shaders now takes about 9 minutes and packing about 15 seconds. These changes were tested on a PC; phone timings will follow.

### No setup needed
Same shader translation and engine as v0.88 to v0.90: install and press Play.

### Install
Install **GalarNative-v0.91.apk** over your current version. versionCode 91.

Здесь собраны все изменения от **v1.2.1** до **v1.2.18** порта статической перекомпиляции Mass Effect (2007) для Android и Linux.

## Что нового в v1.2.18
- **Режим экрана (растягивание на весь экран)**: добавлена настройка `port.stretch_mode` с тремя режимами:
  - **По размеру (Fit)** — сохранение пропорций 16:9 с чёрными полосами (letterbox).
  - **Растянуть (Stretch)** — заполнение всего экрана без сохранения пропорций.
  - **Заполнить (Fill)** — масштабирование на весь экран с обрезкой краёв без искажения картинки.
- Настройка доступна в UI лаунчера Android и передаётся в игру через переменную окружения `ME1_STRETCH_MODE`.
- Оба пути рендеринга (GLES и Vulkan) теперь поддерживают динамический расчёт Viewport в зависимости от выбранного режима.

# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |
| ADPF-цель / `uclamp.min` | — | — | 8 мс / 512 | 8 мс / 1024 |
| Лимит FPS | 30 | — | — | — |

releases.body:
## Что нового

### Linux — новая платформа
- Порт игры на Linux (x86-64 и aarch64): X11 и Wayland, рендеры OpenGL ES, Vulkan и Zink. Клавиатура, мышь с захватом
  (Ctrl+Alt+M — отпустить или захватить), геймпады с вибрацией и горячим подключением, звук.
- Свой лаунчер `me1-launcher`, повторяющий Android-версию: выбор папки игры, автоподбор настроек под видеокарту,
  графика, моды, DLC, переменные окружения, журнал запуска. До первого кадра игры показывается экран загрузки.
- Разумные значения по умолчанию: Vulkan на дискретной видеокарте, разрешение рабочего стола, без ограничения FPS,
  точная эмуляция float D3D9 (без чёрных и белых точек).
- Установка через `linux/install.sh` (ярлык, иконка, удаление через `--uninstall`).

### Сборка
- Два скрипта в корне исходников — `build-linux.sh` и `build-android.sh` (справка по `-h`).
- Сами находят игру (Steam, в том числе Flatpak и Snap, `~/Games`, `~/GOG Games`, папки Wine) или берут её из `--game`.
- Сами находят `msvcr80`, `msvcp80` и `d3dx9_31`: в папке игры, префиксах Proton и Wine, на разделе Windows или
  достают из установщиков `vcredist_x86.exe` и DirectX. Версии DLL проверяются, заглушки Wine отбрасываются.

releases.body:
# WinLite v1.4.0

## Overview
A release focused on rendering smoothness, a new X11 server and Steam support.

---

## 🎮 BETA - Steam
- Steam client support added.

---

## 🖥️ X11 server (rewritten in Rust)
The built-in X server has been rewritten from scratch in Rust and now covers much more of the X11 protocol.

**What you get**
- **Stability.** Memory-safe code removes a whole class of crashes and hangs.
- **Better game and launcher compatibility.** Newer screen-configuration (RANDR 1.2) and rendering extensions are supported, so Wine, launchers and games see a more complete environment.
- **Proper mouse cursors.** System cursors are drawn from a built-in cursor set, and colored/semi-transparent and animated cursors are supported.
- **Better frame pacing.** Frame presentation is synchronized with the real display refresh rate and with fences, which gives the renderer and the FPS limiter an accurate clock to work from.
- **Faster window drawing.** The shared frame buffer is locked once per operation instead of repeatedly, and more drawing requests (lines, rectangles, area clears) are handled directly.

releases.body:
## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 316 (5a66c89)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.

## Changes since build 177

Built from nx2 9fbffe253b plus 11 pull requests that merged into nx2 after it (the test/all-in-one-3 branch at be1f4d9c84). Build 177 was 87d84d513c. That's 152 merged changes, 69 of them from community contributors.

Later launches should be fast again. If a second launch of the same build still rebuilds most shaders, send the log from Help → Report a Bug (Ctrl+F12): we're looking into reports of this.

## Changes since build 160

Built from nx2 87d84d513c. Build 160 was 2eb5f08. That's 86 merged changes.

> **The yuzu name is gone.** The build system, source folders, Qt frontend, translations, emulator libraries and docs now say Lichii instead of the name inherited from yuzu. Your settings, saves and shader caches are kept: config keys, data folders and cache formats don't change, and the few on-disk names that still carry the old name (the shader cache's file magic, the save-size file inside saves, the import path for yuzu data) stay as they are. The program files are still called `lichii`, `eden-cli` and `eden-room`. On macOS the app's bundle id changed, so macOS asks for camera and input permission again (#1541, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1544, #1582).

### Big fixes

## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).
